+from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends
+from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer
+from fastapi.openapi.utils import get_openapi
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+oauth2_scheme_1 = OAuth2PasswordBearer(
+    tokenUrl="token",
+    scopes={"scope1": "Description 1"}
+)
+oauth2_scheme_2 = OAuth2PasswordBearer(
+    tokenUrl="token",
+    scopes={"scope2": "Description 2"}
+)
+
+@app.get("/items/", dependencies=[Depends(oauth2_scheme_1)])
+async def read_items():
+    return [{"item": "Foo"}]
+
+@app.get("/users/", dependencies=[Depends(oauth2_scheme_2)])
+async def read_users():
+    return [{"user": "Bar"}]
+
+def test_openapi_security_schemes():
+    openapi_schema = get_openapi(
+        title="Test OpenAPI",
+        version="1.0.0",
+        routes=app.routes,
+    )
+    
+    components = openapi_schema.get("components", {})
+    security_schemes = components.get("securitySchemes", {})
+    
+    print(f"Security Schemes: {security_schemes}")
+    
+    # Check if both scopes are present in the security scheme
+    oauth2_scheme = security_schemes.get("OAuth2PasswordBearer", {})
+    flows = oauth2_scheme.get("flows", {})
+    password_flow = flows.get("password", {})
+    scopes = password_flow.get("scopes", {})
+    
+    print(f"Scopes: {scopes}")
+    
+    assert "scope1" in scopes, "scope1 missing from security scheme"
+    assert "scope2" in scopes, "scope2 missing from security scheme"
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_openapi_security_schemes()
+        print("Test passed!")
+    except AssertionError as e:
+        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
+        exit(1)
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
+        exit(1)

+def _merge_security_schemes(
+    existing: Dict[str, Any], new: Dict[str, Any]
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    for name, definition in new.items():
+        if name in existing:
+            existing_def = existing[name]
+            if (
+                isinstance(existing_def, dict)
+                and existing_def.get("type") == "oauth2"
+                and isinstance(definition, dict)
+                and definition.get("type") == "oauth2"
+            ):
+                existing_flows = existing_def.get("flows", {})
+                new_flows = definition.get("flows", {})
+                for flow_name, flow_details in new_flows.items():
+                    if flow_name in existing_flows:
+                        existing_flow = existing_flows[flow_name]
+                        existing_scopes = existing_flow.get("scopes", {})
+                        new_scopes = flow_details.get("scopes", {})
+                        if isinstance(existing_scopes, dict) and isinstance(new_scopes, dict):
+                            existing_scopes.update(new_scopes)
+                            existing_flow["scopes"] = existing_scopes
+                    else:
+                        existing_flows[flow_name] = flow_details
+                existing_def["flows"] = existing_flows
+            else:
+                existing[name] = definition
+        else:
+            existing[name] = definition
+    return existing
+
